nodes.speaker: voice_insight
nodes.text: Wait. Something here doesn't feel quite right.

nodes.speaker: voice_insight
nodes.text: The notices are almost all at the same height, except one. That one is higher, and crooked, and the tape at its corners is messy. It doesn't look like school staff put it up.

nodes.speaker: voice_insight
nodes.text: A noticeboard with a few sheets on it. What else?

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You read the top two: wanted to rent, one flat in the school catchment area; and lost property: 'Found yesterday afternoon at break in front of the school storeroom, one packet of instant noodle snacks. If it's yours, call 142676530.' The third has been turned over and stuck down, but it hasn't been torn off.

nodes.speaker: voice_inference
nodes.text: This yard is the same as ever: small, run-down, the ground all cracked. But it has plenty of shortcuts you'd never expect.

nodes.speaker: voice_inference
nodes.text: There's a seam down the middle of the concrete, so the yard was poured in two goes. The seam runs all the way to the other end, yet the main gate happens to open on this side.

nodes.speaker: voice_inference
nodes.text: A yard. Two hoops, a shed, a bench. Wait! Why is one of the hoops facing away from the court?

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You've seen this yard before. Or maybe every school yard looks about the same. No, hardly any school has a yard this run-down. You vaguely remember that the yard was always redone just before graduation.

nodes.speaker: voice_scrutiny
nodes.text: Hold on. Look at where the hoop's pole is set.

nodes.speaker: voice_scrutiny
nodes.text: The concrete around the pole is newer than the rest of the yard, and the backboard looks a bit odd. There are a few old bolt holes in the ground too, for fixing an iron pole, also painted over in dark blue. The hoop must have stood somewhere else before. There should be a base.

nodes.speaker: voice_scrutiny
nodes.text: The rim's height looks fine. It's just facing the wrong way.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You couldn't say how high a normal hoop is meant to be. But the concrete around the base is a different colour, and the net looks newer than the rim. And this hoop is no use at all. It's been put in facing the wrong way.
